Name: 3D-struction
Overview: Eye-popping 3D visuals on your 3DTV or with colored glasses! The classic brick-breaking game explodes into a new dimension as you bounce balls down 35 levels of 3D blocks, alone or with a friend. Clear the field quickly using 1, 2, or 4 thumbs, and create point Combos to get maximum Stars! Variable-Depth 3D modes including 3D-TV and Anaglyph - running in Smooth 1080p.
